hits.author: labmanager
hits.story_text:
Our lab applies to ~30 grants a year and we track them in a shared spreadsheet that nobody keeps up to date.

Deadlines get missed, and we can't tell which reviewers' comments we already addressed. I've looked at https://example.org/grants but it's built for big universities.

What do other researchers use? Anything > a spreadsheet would help.
hits.title: Ask HN: Is there a tool for tracking which grants a lab applied to?

hits.author: ci_sufferer
hits.story_text:
About 5% of our CI runs fail on tests that pass on retry. We quarantine them by hand, but the list keeps growing and developers have stopped trusting red builds.

How do you deal with this at scale? Do you auto-retry, auto-quarantine, or something else?
hits.title: Ask HN: How do you deal with flaky tests in a large monorepo?
